_meta.description: HOOK text-cleaning ground truth — garbage in, clean text out, exact match (no ambiguity, unlike the Context Memory bench's assertions). Three groups: (1) Luna Translator's 5 canonical HOOK dedup patterns isolated, (2) regressions that must survive on both routes unchanged, (3) gaps that differ by underlying mechanism (3a: route-wiring gap, fixed by Fase 1 consolidation; 3b: cjkOnly-restriction gap, only fixable by Fase 3 relaxing it, and only if it does not break group 2).
_meta.routesNote: Each entry is run through BOTH composed routes (cleanViaTcpRoute, cleanViaLauncherRoute in scripts/lib/hook-cleaning-snapshot.js). Entries with a real Textractor hook prefix in `input` should set `hookPrefixed: true` so the bench knows to pass it through as-is for the TCP route and strip it before the launcher route (which never sees the prefix in production — the launcher parses it separately, see textractor-launcher.js's _parseHookLine).

v3.13.20: real Textractor+KiriKiriZ artifact reported by Lyca. isDoubledText's 60%-of-pairs ratio was measured over the WHOLE string, so an artifact glued to the front of a real sentence diluted the ratio below threshold and nothing got cleaned — confirmed by direct execution before the fix (both routes left this completely untouched). Fixed by walking the message word-by-word and testing each word individually against the same threshold, localizing the fix to the leading doubled run instead of requiring the entire message to qualify.

Same class as G2_doubled_embedded_and but with the artifact spanning TWO doubled words before real text starts — guards that the word-by-word walk keeps consuming consecutive qualifying words (not just the first one) and stops cleanly at the first word that doesn't qualify on its own.

Third real artifact reported by Lyca alongside G2_doubled_embedded_and, deliberately left as a documented non-fix. Doesn't match isDoubledText's pair-ratio shape (verified: 1/7 pairs match) NOR detectGrowingPrefix's exact triangular-length shape even in isolation (verified by direct execution: reconstruction doesn't match byte-for-byte) — it's some other, more irregular artifact shape. Expected == input on purpose: no algorithm should claim to fix this from a single example. Needs more real hook captures from Lyca before designing anything, same exact-verification standard already used for #10-12 in Group 1.

Route-composition gap, confirmed asymmetric today: launcher route correctly un-doubles this via _isDoubledText/_unDoubleText; TCP route has no equivalent step at all and leaves it completely untouched. Fixed by Fase 1 applying the same doubled-text check to both routes — NOT a cjkOnly question, this mechanism has no CJK restriction, it's simply missing from one route entirely.
